### ***Test Scenario 12 \- Verify the Monitored Fitment (MF) Marking/Unmarking Functionality***

**Test Case 1 :** Verify that the FTS user can able to Mark the Axle as Monitored fitment

Step 1 \- Login to the application

Step 2 \- Click on Menu bar

Step 3 \- Navigate to the Vehicle Page

Step 4 \- Click on any Customer in the Dropdown

Step 5 \- Click on any Vehicle listed in the page

Step 6 \- Long Press on the Axle Which is Going to Marked as MF

Step 7 \- Click on the Submit button

Step 8 \- Verify that the FTS user can able to Mark the Axle as Monitored fitment

**Test Case 2 :** Verify that the FTS user cannot able to Mark the Axle as Monitored fitment if the Tyre wear is \>20%

Step 1 \- Login to the application

Step 2 \- Click on Menu bar

Step 3 \- Navigate to the Vehicle Page

Step 4 \- Click on any Customer in the Dropdown

Step 5 \- Click on any Vehicle listed in the page

Step 6 \- Long Press on the Axle Which is Going to Marked as MF

Step 7 \- Verify that the FTS user cannot able to Mark the Axle as Monitored fitment if the Tyre wear is \>20%

**Test Case 3 :** Verify that the FTS user can able to Unmark the Axle as Monitored fitment

Step 1 \- Login to the application

Step 2 \- Click on Menu bar

Step 3 \- Navigate to the Vehicle Page

Step 4 \- Click on any Customer in the Dropdown

Step 5 \- Click on any Vehicle listed in the page

Step 6 \- Long Press on the Axle Which is Going to Unmarked as MF

Step 7 \- Click on the Submit button

Step 8 \- Verify that the FTS user can able to Unmark the Axle as Monitored fitment

**Test Case 4 :** Verify that the RFTS user can able to Mark the Axle as Monitored fitment

Step 1 \- Login to the application

Step 2 \- Click on Menu bar

Step 3 \- Navigate to the Vehicle Page

Step 4 \- Click on any Customer in the Dropdown

Step 5 \- Click on any Vehicle listed in the page

Step 6 \- Long Press on the Axle Which is Going to Marked as MF

Step 7 \- Click on the Submit button

Step 8 \- Verify that the RFTS user can able to Mark the Axle as Monitored fitment

**Test Case 5 :** Verify that the RFTS user cannot able to Mark the Axle as Monitored fitment if the Tyre wear is \>20%

Step 1 \- Login to the application

Step 2 \- Click on Menu bar

Step 3 \- Navigate to the Vehicle Page

Step 4 \- Click on any Customer in the Dropdown

Step 5 \- Click on any Vehicle listed in the page

Step 6 \- Long Press on the Axle Which is Going to Marked as MF

Step 7 \- Verify that the RFTS user cannot able to Mark the Axle as Monitored fitment if the Tyre wear is \>20%

**Test Case 5 :** Verify that the RFTS user can able to Unmark the Axle as Monitored fitment

Step 1 \- Login to the application

Step 2 \- Click on Menu bar

Step 3 \- Navigate to the Vehicle Page

### ***Test Scenario 13 \- Verify the Tyre Inspection Functionality***

**Test Case 1 :** Verify that the user can able to view the Tyre Inspection Page

Step 1 \- Login to the application

Step 2 \- Click on the Menu bar

Step 3 \- Navigate to the Vehicles page

Step 4 \- Click on any Vehicle in the List

Step 5 \- Click on the Start Inspection button

Step 6 \- Verify that the user can able to view the Tyre Inspection Page

**Test Case 2 :** Verify that the user can able to Inspect a Tyre

Step 1 \- Login to the application

Step 2 \- Click on the Menu bar

Step 3 \- Navigate to the Vehicles page

Step 4 \- Click on any Vehicle in the List

Step 5 – Click on the Start Inspection button.

Step 6 – Enter valid data in the Tyre Inspection form.

Step 7 – Click on the Next button and fill in the required details for each tyre by navigating through the form using the Next button.

Step 8 – After entering all the required tyre details, click on the Submit button.

**Test Case 3 :** Verify that a alert message is displayed when attempting to submit without inspecting the monitored fitment tyre.

Step 1 \- Login to the application

Step 2 \- Click on the Menu bar

Step 3 \- Navigate to the Vehicles page

Step 4 \- Click on any Vehicle in the List

Step 5 – Click on the Start Inspection button.

Step 6 – Enter valid data in the Tyre Inspection form.

Step 7 – Try to Submit without Inspecting the Monitored Fitment axle tyre

Step 8 – Verify that a alert message is displayed

### ***Test Scenario 14 \- Verify the Tyre Rotation Functionality***

**Test Case 1 :** Verify that the user can view the Tyre Rotation page and that the tyre details are listed in the form.

Step 1 \- Login to the application

Step 2 \- Click on the Menu bar

Step 3 \- Navigate to the Vehicles page

Step 4 \- Click on any Vehicle in the List

Step 5 – Click on the Start Inspection button.

Step 6 \- Click on the Rotation Button

Step 7 \-  Verify that the user can view the Tyre Rotation page and that the tyre details are listed in the form.

**Test Case 2 :** Verify the Tyre Rotation Functionality.

Step 1 \- Login to the application

Step 2 \- Click on the Menu bar

Step 3 \- Navigate to the Vehicles page

Step 4 \- Click on any Vehicle in the List

Step 5 – Click on the Start Inspection button.

Step 6 \- Navigate to the Tyre Rotation Form

Step 7 \- Drag and Drop the first rotating Tyre into the Tyre Basket

Step 8 \- Drag and Drop other Tyres for the Rotation

Step 9 \- Click on the Submit button.

Step 10 \- Verify the Tyre Rotated Successfully

**Test Case 3 :** Verify that a validation message is displayed when submitting without fitting any tyre from the tyre basket to the vehicle.

Step 1 \- Login to the application

Step 2 \- Click on the Menu bar

Step 3 \- Navigate to the Vehicles page

Step 4 \- Click on any Vehicle in the List

Step 5 – Click on the Start Inspection button.

Step 6 \- Navigate to the Tyre Rotation Form

Step 7 \- Drag and Drop the first rotating Tyre into the Tyre Basket

Step 8 \- Drag and Drop other Tyres for the Rotation

Step 9 \- Click on the Submit button without fitting the tyre form the Tyre Basket to the Vehicle.

Step 10 \- Verify that the validation is shown when submitting  without fitting any tyre from the tyre basket to the vehicle.

**Test Case 4 :** Verify that an alert message is displayed when fitting a tyre in the MF axle if the tyre wear is \> 20%.

Step 1 \- Login to the application

Step 2 \- Click on the Menu bar

Step 3 \- Navigate to the Vehicles page

Step 4 \- Click on any Vehicle in the List

Step 5 – Click on the Start Inspection button.

Step 6 \- Navigate to the Tyre Rotation Form

Step 7 \- Drag and Drop the first rotating Tyre into the Tyre Basket

Step 8 \- Drag and Drop other Tyre which has the Tyre Wear \>20% into the Monitored Fitment axle

Step 9 \- Verify that an alert message is displayed when fitting a tyre in the MF axle if the tyre wear is \> 20%

**Test Case 5 :** Verify that a alert message is displayed when attempting to submit Rotation of tyre without inspecting the monitored fitment tyre.

Step 1 \- Login to the application

Step 2 \- Click on the Menu bar

Step 3 \- Navigate to the Vehicles page

Step 4 \- Click on any Vehicle in the List

Step 5 – Click on the Start Inspection button.

Step 6 – Enter valid data in the Tyre Rotation form.

Step 7 – Try to Submit without Inspecting the Monitored Fitment axle tyre.

Step 8 – Verify that a alert message is displayed
